title: Add CSV export to the billing table
goal: Let account administrators download the currently filtered billing table as a CSV file.
currentState: The table and filtering already work. The export button is present but has no handler. Currency values are stored in cents.
nextAction: Implement a client-side CSV serializer that exports the filtered rows and formats cents as decimal currency.
decisions: Export only rows visible under the current filters.
Keep all serialization in the browser; no new API endpoint is needed.
Use ISO dates in the CSV to avoid locale ambiguity.

files.purpose: Contains filters, rows, and the export button.

verification: Filter to one customer and confirm the downloaded CSV has only that customer's rows.
Confirm that 12345 cents appears as 123.45 in the CSV.
risks: Do not include internal notes or payment processor IDs in the export.
